title: Probing Preference Representations: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation and Analysis Method for Reward Models

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating input-response pairs from the PKU-SafeRLHF dataset as 'fair' or 'unfair' using GPT-4o, and evaluating reward models by training a classifier to probe their preference representations on this binary fairness dimension.
Alternating the presentation order of response pairs (ya and yb) during pairwise LLM evaluations and discarding inconsistent preference outcomes to address positional evaluation bias.
